mapper.insert: insert into corgi_coupon(bar_id, detail, status) values(#{coupon.barId}, #{coupon.detail}, #{coupon.status})
mapper.select:
SELECT id, detail, bar_id barId from corgi_coupon where bar_id = #{barId}
and `status` = #{status}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into corgi_activity_coupon(activity_id, coupon_id) values(#{activityId}, #{couponId})
mapper.delete: delete from corgi_activity_coupon ac where activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.select:
SELECT id, detail, bar_id barId from corgi_activity_coupon ac join corgi_coupon c on c.id = ac.coupon_id where ac.activity_id = #{activityId}
and c.`status` = #{status}
